# `/machine-mapping-metadata` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /machine-mapping-metadata/v1/target-identity-attributes

`getMachineMappingTargetIdentityAttributesV1` — List target identity attributes — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the identity attribute names that a machine mapping can target. The list always includes **name**, **alias**, **email**, and **uid**. When expanded mapping targets are enabled for the tenant, the list also includes the tenant's searchable identity attributes. When machine account classification is not enabled for the tenant, this API returns `404`.

- Scopes: idn:identity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Returns 200: targetattributes

### GET /machine-mapping-metadata/v1/target-account-attributes

`getMachineMappingTargetAccountAttributesV1` — List target account attributes — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns the account attribute names that a machine mapping can target. The list always includes **name** and **nativeIdentity**. When expanded mapping targets are enabled for the tenant, the list also includes **description**, **environment**, **subtype**, and **businessApplication**. The caller needs the **idn:account:read** right. When machine account classification is not enabled for the tenant, this API returns `404`.

- Scopes: idn:accounts:manage, idn:accounts:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Returns 200: targetattributes
